articles.summary: THE COMPANY ALSO ANNOUNCES A NEW 5% SHARE REPURCHASE PLAN WESTFIELD, Mass., Oct. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Western New England Bancorp, Inc. (the “Company” or “WNEB”) (NasdaqGS: WNEB), the holding company for Westfield Bank (the “Bank”), announced today the unaudited results of operations for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026.
